aggregation.annual_rule: mean of the monthly anomalies of a calendar year, requiring >= 9 valid months per cell; complete calendar years only

encoding.decode: bytes = DecompressionStream('gzip'); v = Int8Array[(yi * n_lat + row) * n_lon + col]; v === -128 ? missing : celsius = v * 0.1 - offset_int * 0.01 (offset from baseline_offsets, null = unavailable)
encoding.layout: C-order [year][lat][lon]; lat rows north to south, lon columns west to east

quantization.tradeoff: 0.1 C Int8 steps: worst-case 0.05 C error vs typical cell-year noise above 0.3 C. 2 degree (GISTEMP) keeps coastlines and islands; a 4 degree grid would be about 3x smaller but blur them. Year-major order gzips better than cell-major; delta coding was worse (measured).
